definitions.explanation: The area surrounding or near a particular place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧{付近|ふきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are many restaurants near the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{付近|ふきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦らしい→らしい：noentry⟧。
examples.english: It seems there was an accident in this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧{付近|ふきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}→駐車：01466_chuusha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Parking is prohibited near the school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧{付近|ふきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
examples.english: The noise is terrible near the airport.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{付近|ふきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Is there a bank near here?

notes:
{付近|ふきん} is often attached directly to nouns without a particle to mean 'near [place]'.

Usage patterns:
- [place]{付近|ふきん} - near [place], in the vicinity of [place]
- この{付近|ふきん} - this area, around here

Similar words:
- {近く|ちかく} (nearby - more casual)
- {周辺|しゅうへん} (surroundings - broader area)
- {辺り|あたり} (around, vicinity - more casual)
- {近所|きんじょ} (neighborhood - specifically residential areas)
